_comment: Page copy for /for-partners. `unlocks` was drafted as placeholder text and has not been reviewed by the team — check it before treating it as final. Funders and audiences on the page are not here: they are read from the Live initiatives and tools.

unlocks.title: Where additional funding would go
unlocks.lead: The constraint is not ideas but evidence and coverage: proving what the systems already running actually change, extending them to the places and domains asking for them, and sustaining the shared layer everything else depends on.

items.title: Independent impact assessment
items.body: Commission the studies that would let the claims above carry citations rather than caveats — repeating the Timor-Leste assessment design across the Western Indian Ocean deployments and extending it to the aquaculture work.

items.title: Extend across domains, not only countries
items.body: The monitoring and modelling stack was built for fisheries and is already partly reused for aquaculture and climate work. Completing that crossover — and connecting it to nutrition and genetics — is cheaper than building each domain its own system, but it is not free.

items.title: Keep the public goods public
items.body: The standards, ontologies and open platforms underneath the portfolio are used well beyond WorldFish and generate no revenue. They need sustaining funding rather than project funding.
